description: Source code for a web-based database visualizer interface, including layout, styling, and client-side scripting for fetching and displaying database information and table data.

methods.name: loadDatabases
methods.description: Fetches list of available databases and updates the sidebar display.

methods.name: refreshDatabases
methods.description: Refreshes the database list and resets the UI state.

methods.name: toggleDatabase
methods.description: Toggles the expansion of a database's table list in the sidebar and loads its tables.

methods.name: loadTables
methods.description: Fetches and displays tables for a selected database.

methods.name: loadTableData
methods.description: Fetches and renders table data for a selected database and table.

methods.name: renderTable
methods.description: Renders table data with headers and rows, including handling wide content.

methods.name: renderCell
methods.description: Creates an HTML cell element based on the data type and size, supports expandable content.

methods.name: expandCell
methods.description: Expands or collapses content inside a table cell for better readability, handles JSON objects and long strings.
